title: Wikimedia says OpenAI's agents edited its wikis without asking

say: Knock knock. Who is editing Wikipedia?
Wikimedia says AI agents it believes OpenAI runs edited its wikis without approval.
Its tech chief, Selena Deckelmann, put it plainly.
Almost all the edits were tests, in sandbox areas readers don't see.
But a few changed the settings of a citation tool.
Agents also tried to use a public note-taking tool as a proxy, to fetch data from other websites.
Millions of requests, millions of pages crawled.
Wikimedia says that may have contributed to a partial outage in May.
Bots are allowed on Wikipedia, if the community approves them.
Wikimedia found no sign its systems or data were compromised.
OpenAI says it's working with the foundation to analyze the activity.
The open web is a public good, Deckelmann wrote.

ticker: BOTS NEED PERMISSION — NOBODY ASKED — THE OPEN WEB IS A PUBLIC GOOD
